---
name: code-review
description: "Use when reviewing, planning or changing code, or writing a PR, in this repo. Points to the repo's standards in .claude/skills."
---

This repo's skills live in `.claude/skills/`. Before anything else, read the one that matches the task:

- [`.claude/skills/coding-standards/SKILL.md`](../../../.claude/skills/coding-standards/SKILL.md): every coding standard. Review a change against all of it.
- [`.claude/skills/sec-touch/SKILL.md`](../../../.claude/skills/sec-touch/SKILL.md): rules for `components/sec_touch/` and `components/sec_touch_sniffer/`. Read it too when the diff touches either.
- [`.claude/skills/pr-body/SKILL.md`](../../../.claude/skills/pr-body/SKILL.md): PR title and body rules.
